messages:
jamie: Need a new GPU nodepool in us-west3-edge for low-latency customers. Can we provision ~6 nodes (a mix of A10G compact + 1 H100) in a private subnet? constraints: egress IPs are limited and quotas are tight.

alex: What quota numbers do we have left in that region? also do we need preemptible/spot for the A10Gs to save cost?

ravi: Quick thought — H100 single node for stable low-latency; A10G as burst pool with nodes:min=0,max=5. Use taints `gpu=burst:NoSchedule` and nodepool labels for routing. Cluster-autoscaler expander: `least-waste` works well for mixed sizes.

jamie: Yes exactly. Want autoscaler configured so H100 never scales down below 1. A10G should be preemptible. Also need NAT egress via shared NAT gateway — can't allocate new public IPs.

sasha: Who owns the NAT / egress IPs for that VPC? If we reuse shared NAT we'll need to reserve / bump existing NAT to avoid ephemeral collisions.

infra-bot: quota-check results for project:redwood-prod in us-west3-edge -> GPUs: available A10G: quota 8, used 4, free 4; H100: quota 1, used 0, free 1; vCPUs: 120 free; external IPs: 6 free. (run-id: qc-1778889999)

mia_oncall: If H100 quota is 1, reserve it immediately. We had a customer outage last month when quota was claimed mid-provision.

leo: For Terraform, here's a small snippet I used for a similar mixed pool (adapt as needed):

```
resource "google_container_node_pool" "edge-gpu-burst" {
  name = "edge-gpu-burst"
  node_config {
    machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g" // A10G compact
    preemptible = true
    oauth_scopes = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    labels = { pool = "edge-burst" }
    taints = [{ key = "gpu", value = "burst", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE" }]
  }
  autoscaling { min_node_count = 0; max_node_count = 5 }
}
```

jamie: Nice. We'll need a second node_pool for the H100 with min=1,max=1, preemptible=false and a dedicated service account.

alex: Confirming egress: we should annotate the nodepool with `cloud.google.com/egress-via-nat=true`? Or just ensure subnet uses the shared NAT. Need networking signoff.

sasha: I'll check the shared NAT allocation. If external IPs < 3 we'll need to ask infra-networking to expand. ETA? ~2 business days.

ravi: Also recommend enabling `scaleDownDelay` to 10m and `maxPodGracePeriod` to 30 for the burst pool; reduces flapping when preemptibles come back.

jamie: Agreed. Cost note: A10G preemptible saves ~60% vs on-demand. We'll document expected $$ burn in the ticket.

mia_oncall: Heads-up: add alert when cluster-autoscaler can't place pods for 10m -> page eng-oncall. We saw silent failures last quarter.

leo: I'll open a PR with TF changes and a draft HLD. tagging @sasha for NAT details and @ravi for autoscaler config review.

jamie: Opening support ticket for H100 quota increase to be safe. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-5421

infra-bot: created ticket INF-5421 (H100 quota reserve) assigned to quotas-team.

alex: Once INF-5421 is ACKed we can set up a canary: spin up 1 H100 + 1 A10G in a sandbox cluster. schedule for tomorrow morning?

jamie: Tomorrow 09:30 PT works for me. I'll post the runbook in the RFC PR. :thumbsup:
